categories.name: Career Development
categories.description: Invest an hour in your professional future. From polishing your resume to building your network, these activities move your career forward one focused step at a time.

activities.name: Review and update your resume
activities.description: Refresh your resume with recent achievements, sharpen the wording, and make sure it tells a clear story of your career so far.

activities.name: Update your LinkedIn profile
activities.description: Bring your LinkedIn up to date with a current headline, summary, and skills so the right opportunities can find you.

activities.name: Create a professional development plan
activities.description: Map out the skills, certifications, and experience you want to gain over the next year, and the steps to get there.

activities.name: Learn about leadership principles
activities.description: Explore what makes great leaders effective, from delegation to giving feedback, and pick one principle to practice this week.

activities.name: Create a career roadmap
activities.description: Sketch out where you want to be in one, three, and five years, and the milestones that will get you there.

activities.name: Research companies you'd like to work for
activities.description: Build a shortlist of companies that excite you and dig into their culture, openings, and growth.

activities.name: Practice answering common interview questions
activities.description: Rehearse your answers to classic interview questions out loud so the real thing feels familiar.

activities.name: Attend a virtual networking event
activities.description: Join an online industry meetup or webinar and aim to make at least one genuine new connection.

activities.name: Learn about salary negotiation techniques
activities.description: Study proven negotiation tactics so you can confidently make the case for what you're worth.

activities.name: Create or update your professional portfolio
activities.description: Gather your best work into a polished portfolio that shows what you can do at a glance.

activities.name: Research industry salary benchmarks
activities.description: Find out what people in your role and region actually earn so you can plan your next move with real data.

activities.name: Create an elevator pitch for yourself
activities.description: Craft a confident 30-second summary of who you are and what you do, then practice until it flows naturally.

activities.name: Learn about remote work best practices
activities.description: Discover habits and tools that make remote work productive, from async communication to boundary setting.

activities.name: Develop your personal brand statement
activities.description: Define what you want to be known for professionally and distill it into a memorable one-liner.

activities.name: Ask a colleague or mentor for feedback
activities.description: Request honest feedback on one area of your work and listen without defending — it's the fastest way to grow.

activities.name: Write a brag document of your achievements
activities.description: Start a running list of your wins, big and small — gold dust for reviews, resumes, and confidence dips.

activities.name: Research a certification in your field
activities.description: Find out which certifications carry real weight in your industry and what it takes to earn one.

activities.name: Reconnect with a former colleague
activities.description: Send a genuine catch-up message to someone you enjoyed working with — networks are built one message at a time.

activities.name: Set up job alerts for your dream role
activities.description: Create saved searches and alerts so the perfect opening lands in your inbox instead of passing you by.

activities.name: Identify a skill gap and find a course for it
activities.description: Compare your skills against job ads for your target role, spot the gap, and find a course that closes it.

categories.name: Organization
categories.description: Bring order to your space, schedule, and digital life. Small organizing wins compound into calmer days and sharper focus.

activities.name: Organize your workspace
activities.description: Clear your desk, sort the clutter, and set up a workspace that helps you focus.

activities.name: Clean up your computer files
activities.description: Sort your downloads and documents into sensible folders and delete what you no longer need.

activities.name: Create a to-do list for the week
activities.description: Capture everything on your plate and turn it into a realistic, prioritized plan for the week ahead.

activities.name: Set up a filing system
activities.description: Create a simple home for paperwork and documents so you can find anything in seconds.

activities.name: Organize your email inbox
activities.description: Archive the backlog, unsubscribe from the noise, and set up folders so new mail has a home.

activities.name: Declutter your digital workspace
activities.description: Tidy your desktop, close those 47 browser tabs, and uninstall apps you never use.

activities.name: Create a document naming convention system
activities.description: Decide on a consistent way to name files and folders so future-you can find things instantly.

activities.name: Set up a password manager
activities.description: Move your passwords into a secure manager and replace weak, reused ones while you're at it.

activities.name: Organize your browser bookmarks
activities.description: Prune dead links and sort your bookmarks into folders you'll actually use.

activities.name: Create a system for tracking important dates
activities.description: Set up a calendar with birthdays, renewals, and deadlines so nothing catches you by surprise.

activities.name: Digitize important paper documents
activities.description: Scan key documents and store them safely in the cloud so they're backed up and easy to find.

activities.name: Create a meal planning system
activities.description: Build a simple weekly meal-planning routine that saves money and ends the nightly what's-for-dinner debate.

activities.name: Organize your phone apps into folders
activities.description: Group your apps by purpose, delete the ones you never open, and tidy up your home screen.

activities.name: Set up a household supplies inventory
activities.description: Track the consumables you actually run out of — cleaning supplies, batteries, pantry staples — so restocking stops being a guess.

activities.name: Plan your next day the night before
activities.description: Spend ten minutes listing tomorrow's top three priorities so you start the day already knowing what matters.

activities.name: Do a 15-minute declutter sprint
activities.description: Set a timer, grab a bag, and clear as much clutter as you can from one area before it rings.

activities.name: Back up your important files
activities.description: Set up an automatic backup for your photos and documents — before you need it, not after.

activities.name: Create a donation box for unused items
activities.description: Start a box for things you no longer use and drop it off when it's full — decluttering that helps someone else.

activities.name: Sort your photo library into albums
activities.description: Tame your camera roll: delete the duplicates and blurry shots, then sort the keepers into albums.

activities.name: Write a packing checklist template for trips
activities.description: Create a reusable packing list so you never again land somewhere without a charger or toothbrush.

activities.name: Create a personal productivity system
activities.description: Set up a trusted system for capturing tasks, notes, and ideas so nothing slips through.

categories.name: Skills
categories.description: Pick up practical abilities you can use straight away. Each activity builds a skill that makes you more capable at work and at home.

activities.name: Learn a new Excel/Google Sheets function
activities.description: Pick a function like VLOOKUP or pivot tables and practice it on real data until it clicks.

activities.name: Practice typing speed exercises
activities.description: Spend time on a typing trainer and watch your words-per-minute climb.

activities.name: Learn keyboard shortcuts for your OS
activities.description: Master a handful of system shortcuts that will save you minutes every single day.

activities.name: Learn basic coding concepts
activities.description: Try an interactive coding tutorial and get a feel for variables, loops, and logic.

activities.name: Practice public speaking
activities.description: Pick a topic and speak about it for five minutes, recording yourself to spot habits to improve.

activities.name: Learn basic photo editing
activities.description: Learn to crop, adjust exposure, and color-correct your photos with free editing tools.

activities.name: Improve your writing skills with exercises
activities.description: Try short writing drills that sharpen clarity, cut filler, and strengthen your style.

activities.name: Learn to create effective presentations
activities.description: Learn the principles of clear, persuasive slides — and what to leave off them.

activities.name: Practice active listening techniques
activities.description: Practice summarizing, clarifying, and asking open questions in your next conversation.

activities.name: Learn basic video editing
activities.description: Learn cuts, transitions, and titles with a free editor and a few clips from your phone.

activities.name: Learn data visualization basics
activities.description: Discover how to turn raw numbers into honest, easy-to-read charts.

activities.name: Practice speed reading techniques
activities.description: Try techniques like chunking and pacing to read faster without losing comprehension.

activities.name: Learn project management fundamentals
activities.description: Get to grips with scoping, milestones, and prioritization — useful far beyond the office.

activities.name: Study design thinking principles
activities.description: Learn the empathize-define-ideate-prototype-test loop and apply it to a problem of your own.

activities.name: Practice mental math tricks
activities.description: Learn shortcuts for quick percentages, tips, and estimates — handy every single day.

activities.name: Learn the basics of AI tools and prompting
activities.description: Explore what modern AI assistants can do and practice writing prompts that get genuinely useful results.

activities.name: Learn to take better meeting notes
activities.description: Pick up a simple note-taking method that captures decisions and actions, not transcripts.

activities.name: Learn basic graphic design principles
activities.description: Get a feel for contrast, alignment, and hierarchy so everything you make looks more polished.

activities.name: Practice negotiation with role-play scenarios
activities.description: Run through a negotiation scenario out loud — anchoring, trade-offs, and the power of silence.

activities.name: Learn Markdown for faster note-taking
activities.description: Spend 20 minutes learning Markdown and format notes and documents at the speed of typing.

activities.name: Learn about business analytics
activities.description: Explore how businesses use data to make decisions, from KPIs to dashboards.

activities.name: Learn about business communication
activities.description: Sharpen the way you write emails, give updates, and run meetings.

categories.name: Financial
categories.description: Take control of your money in just an hour. These activities build financial confidence, from budgeting basics to long-term planning.

activities.name: Create a budget spreadsheet
activities.description: Build a simple budget that shows what's coming in, what's going out, and where you can save.

activities.name: Learn about investing basics
activities.description: Get a beginner-friendly grounding in index funds, compounding, and risk.

activities.name: Learn about financial planning
activities.description: Learn how to set financial goals and build a plan that connects today's money to tomorrow's life.

activities.name: Review your credit report
activities.description: Pull your free credit report, check it for errors, and learn what's affecting your score.

activities.name: Set up automatic bill payments
activities.description: Automate your regular bills so you never pay a late fee again.

activities.name: Research retirement savings options
activities.description: Understand your pension or retirement account options and check whether you're on track.

activities.name: Learn about tax deductions you may qualify for
activities.description: Spend an hour learning which deductions and allowances apply to you — it could pay for itself many times over.

activities.name: Create an emergency fund savings plan
activities.description: Work out your target emergency fund and set up an automatic transfer to start building it.

activities.name: Research side hustle opportunities
activities.description: Explore realistic ways to earn extra income with the skills and time you already have.

activities.name: Learn about cryptocurrency basics
activities.description: Get a clear-eyed introduction to how crypto works — the technology, the risks, and the hype.

activities.name: Create a debt repayment plan
activities.description: List your debts, compare snowball and avalanche methods, and pick a payoff strategy.

activities.name: Research passive income streams
activities.description: Separate the realistic passive income ideas from the scams and see which could work for you.

activities.name: Review your insurance policies for better deals
activities.description: Check what you're paying for car, home, and gadget cover, and see whether switching could save you money.

activities.name: Set a savings goal for something specific
activities.description: Pick a concrete goal — a trip, a gadget, a buffer — work out the monthly amount, and automate it.

activities.name: Track every expense for one day
activities.description: Write down everything you spend today, however small — awareness is the first step to control.

activities.name: Play with a compound interest calculator
activities.description: Plug your numbers into a compound interest calculator and see what consistent saving actually becomes.

activities.name: Review and cancel unused subscriptions
activities.description: Go through your bank statement, list every subscription, and cancel the ones you'd forgotten you had.

activities.name: Check your pension contributions
activities.description: Find out what you and your employer are paying in, and whether a small increase now would transform later.

categories.name: Personal Growth
categories.description: Become a little better than yesterday. These activities build self-awareness, resilience, and habits that actually stick.

activities.name: Build a focus practice for deep work
activities.description: Train your attention with short, deliberate focus blocks so you can drop into demanding work without reaching for your phone.

activities.name: Learn about emotional intelligence
activities.description: Explore self-awareness, empathy, and emotional regulation — skills that improve every relationship.

activities.name: Practice stress management
activities.description: Learn practical techniques to recognize stress early and bring yourself back to baseline.

activities.name: Map your growth over the next 90 days
activities.description: Pick two things you want to be visibly better at by the end of the quarter and decide exactly how you'll practice them.

activities.name: Read a personal development book
activities.description: Pick up a well-reviewed personal development book and read a chapter with notes.

activities.name: Practice positive self-talk
activities.description: Notice your inner critic and practice reframing harsh thoughts into constructive ones.

activities.name: Learn about cognitive biases
activities.description: Discover the mental shortcuts that distort your thinking — and how to catch them in action.

activities.name: Develop a morning routine
activities.description: Design a realistic morning routine that sets up the rest of your day for success.

activities.name: Practice saying no to unnecessary commitments
activities.description: Review your commitments and practice polite, firm ways to decline what doesn't serve you.

activities.name: Learn time blocking techniques
activities.description: Plan tomorrow in focused blocks and discover how much more you finish with fewer context switches.

activities.name: Study personality type frameworks
activities.description: Explore frameworks like the Big Five and learn what they can (and can't) tell you about yourself.

activities.name: Practice journaling for self-reflection
activities.description: Spend 15 minutes journaling with prompts that help you process the week and spot patterns.

activities.name: Learn about habit formation science
activities.description: Learn how cues, cravings, and rewards drive habits — and use them to build a good one.

activities.name: Write down your top five personal values
activities.description: Identify the five values that matter most to you and check whether your week actually reflects them.

activities.name: Do a weekly review of wins and lessons
activities.description: Look back over the week: what went well, what didn't, and what one thing you'll change next week.

activities.name: Set one goal using the SMART framework
activities.description: Take a vague ambition and make it specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.

activities.name: Write a letter to your future self
activities.description: Write to yourself one year from now — your hopes, worries, and predictions — and seal it for later.

activities.name: Identify and reframe one limiting belief
activities.description: Spot a story you tell yourself about what you can't do, and look for the evidence against it.

activities.name: Start a bucket list of lifetime goals
activities.description: Brainstorm the experiences you want to have in your lifetime — then pick one to start planning.

categories.name: Home Improvement
categories.description: Make your home work better for you. Practical projects and know-how that save money and add comfort.

activities.name: Organize a closet or storage space
activities.description: Empty it out, donate what you don't use, and put back only what earns its place.

activities.name: Deep clean one room in your home
activities.description: Pick one room and give it the full treatment — baseboards, windows, and all the forgotten corners.

activities.name: Learn basic plumbing fixes
activities.description: Learn to fix a dripping faucet, unblock a drain, and find your water shut-off valve before you need it.

activities.name: Research energy efficiency upgrades
activities.description: Find out which insulation, lighting, and heating upgrades would actually cut your bills.

activities.name: Create a home maintenance checklist
activities.description: Build a seasonal checklist of the small jobs that prevent big repair bills.

activities.name: Learn to patch drywall
activities.description: Watch a tutorial and learn to fill holes and patch drywall like a pro.

activities.name: Research smart home devices
activities.description: Compare smart plugs, thermostats, and lights to see which would genuinely make life easier.

activities.name: Plan a furniture rearrangement
activities.description: Sketch your room layout and experiment with arrangements before you move a single sofa.

activities.name: Learn basic electrical safety
activities.description: Learn what's safe to DIY, what isn't, and where your breaker box and shut-offs are.

activities.name: Start a home inventory for insurance
activities.description: Photograph and list your valuables room by room — your future self will thank you.

activities.name: Touch up paint scuffs and marks
activities.description: Grab the leftover paint tin and erase the scuffs and marks that have been bugging you for months.

activities.name: Test your smoke and carbon monoxide alarms
activities.description: Press the test button on every alarm, replace tired batteries, and note when the units expire.

activities.name: Clean or replace air filters and vents
activities.description: Dust the vents and swap clogged filters — better air and lower running costs in under an hour.

activities.name: Fix a squeaky door or loose handle
activities.description: Knock out one of those tiny annoyances: a drop of oil and a tightened screw go a long way.

activities.name: Descale your kettle and showerhead
activities.description: Banish limescale with vinegar or citric acid and get your kettle and shower back to full power.

activities.name: Learn to re-seal a bath or sink
activities.description: Watch a tutorial on removing tired sealant and applying a clean new bead — a satisfying skill for life.

categories.name: Health & Fitness
categories.description: Look after the only body you get. Plan, learn, and build routines that boost your energy and long-term health.

activities.name: Create a weekly workout plan
activities.description: Design a realistic week of exercise that fits your schedule and fitness level.

activities.name: Research healthy meal prep ideas
activities.description: Find batch-cook recipes that make eating well the easy option all week.

activities.name: Learn proper stretching techniques
activities.description: Learn safe stretching form for the muscle groups you use (and neglect) most.

activities.name: Research ergonomic workspace setups
activities.description: Check your chair, screen, and desk height against ergonomic guidance and fix the worst offender.

activities.name: Create a sleep improvement plan
activities.description: Audit your sleep habits and pick two evidence-based changes to try this week.

activities.name: Learn about macro nutrition tracking
activities.description: Understand protein, carbs, and fats — and how to balance them for your goals.

activities.name: Research posture correction exercises
activities.description: Find simple daily exercises that counteract hours of sitting and screen time.

activities.name: Create a hydration tracking system
activities.description: Work out how much water you actually need and set up an easy way to hit it daily.

activities.name: Learn about heart rate zone training
activities.description: Learn what the zones mean and how training in each one changes your fitness.

activities.name: Research stress-reduction techniques
activities.description: Compare evidence-based stress relievers — breathing, exercise, nature — and pick one to test.

activities.name: Do a 20-minute bodyweight workout
activities.description: No equipment needed: squats, push-ups, lunges, and planks in your living room.

activities.name: Take a brisk 30-minute walk
activities.description: Get your heart rate up with a purposeful walk — one of the most underrated workouts there is.

activities.name: Try a beginner yoga video
activities.description: Follow a free beginner yoga session and give your body a gentle full-body reset.

activities.name: Prep healthy snacks for the week
activities.description: Wash, chop, and portion snacks now so the healthy choice is the convenient one all week.

activities.name: Do a guided stretching session
activities.description: Follow a guided full-body stretch routine and release the tension you didn't know you were holding.

activities.name: Schedule overdue health check-ups
activities.description: Book the dentist, optician, or doctor appointment you've been putting off — it takes ten minutes.
